title: 60-minute physical GSLB DNS TCP soak

testSetup.dnsListener: GslbDns binary, bound only to 127.0.0.1:15353 on each host
testSetup.clientPath: dig over TCP through loopback SSH port forwards

limits: The measured client path includes WSL and SSH forwarding; it is not public recursive-resolver or end-user latency.
This is a synthetic DNS TCP soak of two isolated nodes; it does not validate shared public DNS delegation, DNSSEC, production routing, capacity, or 99.9% availability.
No intentional outage or failover was injected during this soak.
